This module provides acecess to [https://www.peak-system.com/PCAN-USB.199.0.html PEAK CAN] devices.

= Configuration =

The '''module_pcan''' can be loaded with the following configuration:

 - name: my_pcan_master
   so_file: libmodule_pcan.so
   config:
     pcan_dev_name: /dev/pcan0
     pcan_msg_type: &lt;standard|extended&gt;
     pcan_baud_rate: &lt;500k|1M|250k|125k|100k|50k|20k|10k|5k&gt;
     slave_modules: [ module1, module2, ... ]
   trigger:                                                                    
   - dev_name: timer.posix_timer.trigger                                     
     divisor: 1                                                              
     direct_mode: false                                                      
     prio: 89                                                                
   power_up: op                                                                
   depends: timer
